# superset_current_user (Data Source)

Describes the user the provider is authenticated as, on Superset 6, for example to make it the owner of the objects it creates. Older versions only answer these endpoints to a browser session, so the data source fails there.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_current_user" "me" {}

# The user the provider runs as owns the dashboard, so it stays editable by that user.
resource "superset_dashboard" "sales" {
  title  = "Sales"
  owners = [data.superset_current_user.me.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the user, for the `owners` of charts, dashboards, datasets and connections.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `roles` (List of String) Names of the roles of the user, sorted.
- `username` (String) Username of the user.
